LanguageData.BOR_Bench_II.label: Kwazifab Quasar Fabricator
LanguageData.BOR_Bench_II.description: A work station for assembling Quasar-based technology, all originally patented within Kwazaari mercantile space.
LanguageData.BOR_Forge_II.label: theta forge
LanguageData.BOR_Forge_II.description: Used to compose Neutronium into usable items.
LanguageData.BOR_MedicineBench_II.label: kwazaari medical fabricator
LanguageData.BOR_MedicineBench_II.description: An offshoot Kwazifab workbench equipped with kwaztainers, kwazheaters, and chemical kwazynthesizers for producing various drugs and medicines, patent pending.
LanguageData.BOR_HydroponicsBasin_II.label: hydrokwaesar 630 gro-master
LanguageData.BOR_HydroponicsBasin_II.description: An artificial nutrient bath for growing plants at blistering speed. Due to limits on the cost of manufacture there is no internal power supply to sustain the apparatus in case of outage. In short: the plants will begin to die if power is cut.
LanguageData.BOR_HydroponicsBasin_Tileable_II.label: hydrokwaesar 630 gro-minor
LanguageData.BOR_HydroponicsBasin_Tileable_II.descrip: A compact and customizable nutrient bath for growing plants at blistering speed. Due to limits on the cost of manufacture there is no internal power supply to sustain the apparatus in case of outage. In short: the plants will begin to die if power is cut.
